title: Soul Snack #74: Every Moment Is Big
excerpt: Learn how to connect with your intuition every day.
bodyHtml:
Learn how to connect with your intuition every day. CLICK HERE to start your journey to authentic power

In this profound Soul Snack, Gary Zukav challenges you to reconsider everything you think you know about the significance of your daily life. He reveals that from a multisensory perspective, every moment in your life carries the same weight and evolutionary significance – not just the milestones or “special occasions” the five-sensory personality has been conditioned to value. Through his compassionate wisdom, Gary guides you to understand that each moment, even those you might dismiss as “ordinary,” presents a powerful opportunity to either react unconsciously from frightened parts of your personality or to apply Emotional Awareness and Responsible Choice to create Authentic Power.

The central problem facing multisensory humanity is the tendency to disempower yourself by dismissing the “now” as insignificant. When you ignore these seemingly small moments, you disregard who you truly are – a powerful, creative, and compassionate Soul. This unconscious dismissal keeps you trapped in repetitive patterns, allowing fear-based reactions to remain in control of your life in the Earth School.

The solution lies in recognizing that creating Authentic Power is heroic work that happens in every single moment. When you use your will to put distance between yourself and your emotional reactions, you move beyond the control of fear and step into your true nature as a Universal Human.

What You’ll Discover in this Episode:

(00:02) — The Birth of a New World: Gary opens with humanity’s unprecedented shift in consciousness and the choice before every individual: gratitude, patience, and awe — or anger, worry, and despair.

(00:43) — It’s Always Yours To Do: Everything on this path belongs entirely to you — not your partner, your parents, or your peers. The work, the growth, and the transformation are all yours.

(01:00) — Your Incarnation Is Your Responsibility: You are fully responsible for what you have created in your incarnation — and that responsibility is not a burden, but a declaration of your power.

(01:12) — You Create Everything in It: Being the creator of your experience isn’t about controlling outcomes — it’s about choosing how you meet every emotion that arises within you.

(01:22) — The Power of Conscious Choice: No one can determine the future, but every person can choose how they respond when emotions arise — and that choice is the foundation of Authentic Power.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

Take a moment this week to notice when you catch yourself dismissing a moment as ordinary or insignificant. When you find yourself thinking “same old, same old,” pause and ask yourself: What opportunity am I missing right now? Am I reacting unconsciously to a frightened part of my personality, or am I choosing to respond consciously? Notice what happens when you shift your perspective and recognize that this moment – right now – is as big as any other moment in your life. Can you honor the heroic opportunity it presents to create authentic power?
